dedupe_keys.name: ops sat ad anomaly benchmark preparation and evaluation code

description: The OPS-SAT-AD project publishes Python notebooks and evaluation code for its annotated satellite-telemetry benchmark in a public GitHub repository under MIT. The own README explains that users can prepare data and compare supervised or unsupervised anomaly detectors against the Zenodo CSV files, with a requirements file for the tested Python environment. This workflow can help assess detection components before they are used in a satellite operations simulator or digital twin. Coverage follows nine selected OPS-SAT sensor channels and the article's fixed train-test split. A caveat is that code results depend on the chosen benchmark release, dependencies and labels; the repository does not itself model satellite dynamics or guarantee fault detection on a different spacecraft. The README links the first Zenodo version DOI, while the article cites its concept DOI, now resolving to a later release. I read own GitHub metadata, README and article code statement without cloning or running the notebooks. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
